reproduction.observed: Browser Back restored the home URL but left the authentication overlay open, body locked, and focus trapped.

defects.rootCause: The examination route opened an authentication overlay without identifying it as route-bound, and the authentication layer did not reconcile the overlay with browser history.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; canonical signed-out production trials remain blocked—AFK because the selected browser is authenticated; the signed-out local behavioral regression passed

defects.surface: authentication overlay focus restoration after responsive resize

reproduction.observed: When the prior trigger became hidden after resizing to mobile, overlay dismissal restored focus to no usable control.

defects.rootCause: Focus restoration trusted the previous element's connection state but not its rendered visibility.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; responsive signed-out live focus verification remains blocked—AFK because the selected browser is authenticated; the local 320px behavioral regression passed

reproduction.observed: A delayed Premium entitlement response reopened Bar Feels after the user had already switched back to Quorum.

defects.rootCause: The asynchronous entitlement request had no navigation-intent invalidation, so a stale response could win after a later menu choice.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; 5/5 live rapid-switch trials passed

defects.surface: Quorum My Posts and Profile navigation

reproduction.observed: My Posts and Profile shared the profile route identity, so both controls appeared active and exposed aria-current=page together.

defects.rootCause: The My Posts control used data-quorum-view="profile" instead of a distinct routable view while the active-state synchronizer correctly keyed from that shared identifier.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; My Posts and Profile each passed 5/5 live route and active-state trials, and My Posts deep-link refresh passed

reproduction.whyFewerThanFive: The static CSS rule removed the same heading from the accessibility tree for every render; source inspection and a DOM snapshot established the invariant.
reproduction.observed: The visually hidden Quorum h2 used display:none and was absent from the accessibility tree.

defects.rootCause: A combined CSS selector applied display:none to both the eyebrow and the semantic title row.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; the Quorum h2 is present in the live accessibility tree

defects.classification: deterministic accessibility contrast and target-size defects
defects.surface: Quorum metadata, status text, affirmation count, and dark practice card

reproduction.whyFewerThanFive: These are static computed-style invariants. Source values, one production DOM/style inspection, and deterministic contrast calculations are stronger than repeated clicks.
reproduction.observed: Several small-text color pairs were below 4.5:1 and the affirmation-count control measured about 16 by 17 CSS pixels without its own focus-visible rule.

defects.rootCause: Scoped Quorum CSS inherited muted colors that were too light on the corresponding surfaces and did not enforce a minimum compact-control target.
defects.productionStatus: deployed in 2a3d570608a2ae408ed9325686121f9745a7ebae; live target measured 24x24 CSS pixels and targeted contrast pairs passed

reproduction.observed: The comments panel opened and closed functionally, but its trigger exposed neither aria-expanded nor aria-controls in any trial.

defects.rootCause: The post renderer created the Comment trigger without a deterministic relationship to the comments region, and toggleComments changed only visual state.

postFixEvidence.redBeforeGreen: The new regression first failed with: Each Comment toggle must identify its controlled comments region.

defects.productionStatus: deployed in bbdd931660c426b6b3c53066e25fcf70e132ba62; 5/5 desktop and 5/5 narrow-viewport live trials passed, with zero browser diagnostic log entries
